issues.quote: He had left them in his coat.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that the doctor went out to fetch his cigars. It gives no location for the cigars or for where he went to get them.
issues.misreading: A solver could infer that he went to a coat stored elsewhere in the house, such as the hall or cloakroom, and so was out of the salon for a longer or different stretch than the 10:28 departure and the 11:00 hall-clock strike suggest. This is a whereabouts hint the sheet does not support.
